notes.title: You Can Finally Play the Demo!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We’ve brought something big. After months of hard work, laser tweaking, and flying ink, we’re here to announce...

[h3]The Tattoo Removal Simulator Demo Is Now LIVE! 🎉[/h3]
Step into the role of a tattoo removal specialist and try the first playable version—right now! Just head over to our Steam page and hit that download button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227964/7da57f59abee39f28ee82a85a2071f7e6750014f.gif[/img]

Or directly install it from the separate Demo page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3747380
[h3]Your Feedback Means Everything 💬[/h3]
This is just the beginning, and your feedback is essential. Drop your thoughts in the comments, Steam discussions, on social media, or leave a review—we’re listening.

[h3]Wishlist to Stay Updated ❤️[/h3]
If you enjoy the demo, please consider adding Tattoo Removal Simulator to your wishlist—it helps a ton and keeps you in the loop for updates, new features, and the official release date once it's ready.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3143910/Tattoo_Removal_Simulator/
[h3]Until Next TIme![/h3]
Thanks for your patience and support—we’re so excited to finally share this slice of weirdly satisfying gameplay with you.

May your lasers stay steady and your clients leave spotless! 😄

—The Tattoo Removal Simulator Team

notes.title: We’re Still Alive! And We’ve Got Something to Show You…
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, everyone![/h2]

It’s been a little while since our last update (we missed you!), but rest assured, we’ve been hard at work breathing life into Tattoo Removal Simulator. Today, we’re excited to share a sneak peek into what we’ve been crafting behind the scenes!

[h2]New Environments: Can You Guess?[/h2]
As a tattoo removal specialist in our game, you won’t be confined to the cozy walls of your clinic. Sometimes, your work will take you to some… unexpected places. We’ve been designing two brand-new environments, and we can’t wait to see what you think!

Take a look at the photos we’ve included below. Can you guess where these environments might be? Drop your guesses in the comments—we’re curious to see who gets it right!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227964/8f1b3b493a8bc888543b96db5757644749cdbdf2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227964/95a5f1924262182784aa3590e148814348735466.png[/img]

[h2]Male Clients Are On the Way![/h2]
While we’re on the topic of updates, we’ve also been finalizing the very first male client model for the game! Although we don’t have a polished photo to share just yet, we’re excited to unveil him in the next update. Stay tuned—it’s going to be worth the wait!

[h2]Goodbye, everyone![/h2]
Your support means the world to us. Don’t forget to wishlist Tattoo Removal Simulator on Steam and follow us for more updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes moments.

As always, may your lasers stay steady and your clients leave spotless! 😄

notes.title: Our big reveal is finally here…
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2]
After years of helping other projects, we're finally bringing our own vision to life! As a team of passionate creators with a love for the game industry, this is a big moment for us, and we’re thrilled to share it with you.

[h2]Introducing Tattoo Removal Simulator![/h2]
In Tattoo Removal Simulator, you’ll step into the shoes of a skilled tattoo removal specialist. Your mission? To help clients turn a new page by erasing colorful tattoos that hold deep personal stories—from love and heartbreak to secrets and regrets.

The game blends a calming, therapeutic gameplay experience with narrative depth, allowing you to uncover the unique tales behind each tattoo while mastering the tools of the trade.

[h2]Check Out Our Trailer![/h2]
Today, we’re excited to reveal our very first gameplay trailer - the first look at what we’ve been crafting! Although the trailer showcases a very early version of the game with just few female characters 🙈 (more are in the works!), we’re thrilled to share it with you and can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see how the community responds! 😄

[previewyoutube=wwdXB6RUlrg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Feedback is welcome![/h2]
We believe in building Tattoo Removal Simulator together with our community—you are the ink that shapes this game. Every suggestion, piece of feedback, and idea fuels our development process and keeps us inspired. If you have interesting ideas or feedback, please feel free to reply to this news post or share it on any of our social media. At Uraga, community feedback is truly cherished, and we can’t wait to hear from you!

[h2]We are on Social Media[/h2]
If you want to keep up with behind the scenes content you can follow our channels. Links can be found down below 👇

[h2]Your wishlist is appreciated more than you think![/h2]
Stay tuned, and feel free to add us to your wishlist if you like what we are creating.

We can’t wait to share some more ink-worthy updates with you! Thank you for joining us on this journey. We’re excited to bring you more updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes moments as we go. Welcome to the beginning of something special! 🎉

May your laser stay steady and your clients leave spotless! 😄
